How to Read The Ledger

Every spoken line runs three scores simultaneously.

PROFIT is the strategic position. What the person is gaining or losing in power, leverage, and material terms. When someone makes a move that puts them ahead — watch the P number move.

LOVE is the relationship. The trust, the history, the goodwill. Most people don't know they're spending it until it's gone. Watch this bleed when someone makes a short-term move that burns the connection doing it.

TAX is the real cost. Not the apparent cost. What the move costs over time — in risk, exposure, reputation, and weight. Taxes accumulate quietly and arrive all at once.

After every spoken line, the ticker shows all three scores for both people simultaneously. The CALL labels what just happened before the numbers land: PROFIT SNATCHED. TAXED. LOVE LIST. LOVE BURNED. BLUNDER. KEEPING LOVE. The number shows how hard it hit.

The read underneath is the corner man between rounds. No announcement — just the voice that names what actually happened and what it costs.

The FINAL SCORE shows where both people landed, how far they traveled, and what the conversation built or destroyed. The diamond rating ◆◆◆◆◆ marks a master-level score.

These conversations happen in every room. The corner, the office, the hospital, the first date, the last conversation before the fight, the one that stops it. The PLT doesn't care where you are. It runs the same equation in every room.

CHAPTER ONE

The Block

Street-level PLT. Where the math is real and the Tax can't be deferred.

Some of the most technically precise conversations on earth happen on corners. The prices are real. The body language is read before the first word. Watch what happens to the scores when someone gets comfortable and when someone gets scared.

First Time

A corner. 3pm. A new face.

ROME the seller. reads new faces before they open their mouth. · MALIK first time buyer. trying not to look it.

OPENING

ROME HOLDING P 72 (—) L 65 (—) T 28 (—) │ PLT 64 ─

MALIK HOLDING P 38 (—) L 54 (—) T 20 (—) │ PLT 44 ─

Rome reads new customers for a living. Malik doesn't know he's already been read.

ROME SMALL TAX P 72 (—) L 65 (—) T 30 (+2) │ PLT 63.2 ▼

MALIK SMALL TAX P 36 (-2) L 54 (—) T 24 (+4) │ PLT 41.6 ▼

The pause before the question. The dropped eyes. Rome clocked three tells before a word came out. New. Nervous. Will overpay. Malik announced his position before the negotiation started.

MALIK SMALL TAX P 36 (—) L 54 (—) T 26 (+2) │ PLT 40.8 ▼

PROFIT SNATCHED +8. Four words that made Malik define his position first. Profit before a dollar has changed hands.

MALIK PROFIT DIP P 34 (-2) L 54 (—) T 28 (+2) │ PLT 39.6 ▼

"Maybe two" is the tell. He's already thinking bigger. Rome heard it. The price just moved.

The two-for-fifty-five looks like a deal. It isn't. Malik's Tax just climbed — he's paying new-customer prices on a market he doesn't know yet.

PROFIT SNATCHED for Tone. Surgical. Compressed the argument to one moment, one transaction, one person. Tone is completely in control.

DARIUS LOVE LIST P 88 (+8) L 72 (+24) T 58 (—) │ PLT 74 ▲

LOVE LIST +24. He burned the Love score down to 40 across five bad lines then rebuilt 32 points in one sentence. A handled complaint builds more trust than a transaction never questioned.

Darius's Love: 70→60→54→40. Four straight lines bled it to the floor. Then +24 in one move. The recovery is the lesson.
